claim: mRNAs are localized in the processes of excitatory neurons
source: Although mRNAs are localized in the processes of excitatory neurons, it is still unclear whether interneurons also localize a large population of mRNAs.
evidence: This is stated as established knowledge in the abstract, contrasting with the unknown status for interneurons

claim: It is unclear whether interneurons localize a large population of mRNAs
source: Although mRNAs are localized in the processes of excitatory neurons, it is still unclear whether interneurons also localize a large population of mRNAs.
evidence: This is explicitly stated as an open question in the abstract

claim: The variability in the localized mRNA population within and between cell types is unknown
source: In addition, the variability in the localized mRNA population within and between cell types is unknown.
evidence: This is explicitly stated as an unknown aspect in the abstract

claim: Interneurons contain a rich repertoire of ~4000 mRNAs in their dendrites
source: We found that, like their excitatory counterparts, interneurons contain a rich repertoire of ~4000 mRNAs.
evidence: This is a primary finding stated in the abstract based on the study's experimental results

claim: More cell type-specific features are observed among somatic transcriptomes than their associated dendritic transcriptomes
source: We observed more cell type-specific features among somatic transcriptomes than their associated dendritic transcriptomes.
evidence: This is a primary finding stated in the abstract based on comparative analysis

claim: The processes of glutamatergic neurons are capable of local translation
source: Finally, using celltype-specific metabolic labeling of isolated neurites, we demonstrated that the processes of glutamatergic and, notably, GABAergic neurons were capable of local translation, suggesting mRNA localization and local translation are general properties of neurons.
evidence: This is demonstrated through cell type-specific metabolic labeling experiments described in the abstract

claim: The processes of GABAergic neurons are capable of local translation
source: Finally, using celltype-specific metabolic labeling of isolated neurites, we demonstrated that the processes of glutamatergic and, notably, GABAergic neurons were capable of local translation, suggesting mRNA localization and local translation are general properties of neurons.
evidence: This is demonstrated through cell type-specific metabolic labeling experiments described in the abstract

claim: mRNA localization and local translation are general properties of neurons
source: Finally, using celltype-specific metabolic labeling of isolated neurites, we demonstrated that the processes of glutamatergic and, notably, GABAergic neurons were capable of local translation, suggesting mRNA localization and local translation are general properties of neurons.
evidence: This is inferred from the observation that both glutamatergic and GABAergic neurons exhibit local translation

claim: Axons and dendrites extend hundreds of micrometers from their cell bodies
source: Because they usually extend hundreds of micrometers from their cell bodies, axons and dendrites must operate with some biochemical and electrical autonomy to accommodate changes at the speed of synaptic transmission.
evidence: This is stated as established knowledge about neuronal morphology

claim: Axons and dendrites must operate with some biochemical and electrical autonomy
source: Because they usually extend hundreds of micrometers from their cell bodies, axons and dendrites must operate with some biochemical and electrical autonomy to accommodate changes at the speed of synaptic transmission.
evidence: This is inferred from the spatial separation of processes from the soma

claim: Neurons control where and when different proteins are made and function by localizing specific mRNAs to axons and dendrites
source: By localizing specific mRNAs to these compartments, a neuron can control where and when different proteins are made and function (Holt et al., 2019).
evidence: This is supported by citation to Holt et al., 2019

claim: Multiple groups have identified transcripts present in dendrites and axons using tissue-derived RNA samples
source: Working with tissue-derived RNA samples, multiple groups have identified transcripts present in dendrites and axons, revealing which proteins are likely generated by local translation (Cajigas et al., 2012; Glock et al., 2020; Gumy et al., 2011; Hafner et al., 2019; Poon et al., 2006; Zhong et al., 2006).
evidence: This is supported by multiple citations to previous studies

claim: Tissue-based approaches forgo fundamental features of local transcriptomes that can only be dissected at the level of individual neurons
source: However, by design, these tissue-based approaches forgo fundamental features of local transcriptomes that can only be dissected at the level of individual neurons.
evidence: This is inferred from the limitations of bulk tissue approaches

claim: It is unclear if subcellular mRNA localization and translation occurs in all types of neurons
source: It is unclear if subcellular mRNA localization and translation occurs in all types of neurons, and whether it varies according to cell type or cell state.
evidence: This is explicitly stated as an open question

claim: Bulk RNA studies of microdissected tissue have profiled mRNAs in neurites
source: On one hand, bulk RNA studies of microdissected tissue (containing multiple cell types) have profiled mRNAs in the neurites (Poon et al., 2006) or brain slice neuropils (Cajigas et al., 2012; Glock et al., 2020; Zhong et al., 2006) providing a comprehensive view of mRNAs localized to the axonal/dendritic population.
evidence: This is supported by citations to previous studies

claim: Quantitative expression values from bulk sequencing approaches do not reflect the actual mRNA values present in an individual neuron
source: However, quantitative expression values obtained from these bulk sequencing approaches do not reflect the actual mRNA values present in an individual neuron, but rather the population average, potentially hiding intercellular heterogeneity in the local transcriptome.
evidence: This is inferred from the nature of bulk sequencing methods

claim: Single cell RNA-seq studies have revealed extensive diversity in cellular composition of the brain
source: On the other hand, unbiased single cell RNA-seq (scRNA-seq) studies circumvent the averaging effect of bulk approaches and have revealed extensive diversity in cellular composition of the brain.
evidence: This is stated as established knowledge from scRNA-seq studies

claim: Single cell RNA-seq methods require the generation of cell suspensions, resulting in the shearing off of neuronal processes
source: However, these methods require the generation of cell suspensions, resulting in the shearing off of neuronal processes and the profiling of exclusively somatic mRNAs (Prakadan et al., 2017).
evidence: This is supported by citation to Prakadan et al., 2017

claim: Most bulk-sequencing studies have attributed the identified mRNAs to excitatory neurons
source: In addition, most bulk-sequencing studies have attributed the identified mRNAs to excitatory neurons; it is still unknown whether local translation occurs in different classes of inhibitory interneurons.
evidence: This is stated as a limitation of previous studies

claim: It is unknown whether local translation occurs in different classes of inhibitory interneurons
source: In addition, most bulk-sequencing studies have attributed the identified mRNAs to excitatory neurons; it is still unknown whether local translation occurs in different classes of inhibitory interneurons.
evidence: This is explicitly stated as an open question

claim: Inhibitory interneurons exhibit diverse size, transmitter phenotype, axonal and dendritic architecture, and electrophysiological properties
source: Indeed a better understanding of the subcellular transcriptome of these neurons may help explain their diverse size, transmitter phenotype, axonal and dendritic architecture, and electrophysiological properties (Huang and Paul, 2019; Pelkey et al., 2017).
evidence: This is supported by citations to Huang and Paul, 2019 and Pelkey et al., 2017

claim: Many of the variable genes act at the synapse
source: Moreover, our growing appreciation of the brain's cell type complexity and the fact that many of the variable genes act at the synapse (Saunders et al., 2018; Zeisel et al., 2018) suggest that the specialization of dendritic and axonal compartments is a critical consequence of cell differentiation.
evidence: This is supported by citations to Saunders et al., 2018 and Zeisel et al., 2018

claim: The specialization of dendritic and axonal compartments is a critical consequence of cell differentiation
source: Moreover, our growing appreciation of the brain's cell type complexity and the fact that many of the variable genes act at the synapse (Saunders et al., 2018; Zeisel et al., 2018) suggest that the specialization of dendritic and axonal compartments is a critical consequence of cell differentiation.
evidence: This is inferred from the observation that variable genes act at synapses

claim: The neuronal soma is the source of mRNA from which local transcriptomes are generated
source: Since it houses the source of transcription (the nucleus), the neuronal soma is the source of mRNA from which local transcriptomes are generated.
evidence: This is inferred from the fact that the nucleus is in the soma

claim: It is unclear how much a transcript's somatic level influences its localization in processes
source: It is unclear, however, how much a transcript's somatic level influences its localization in processes, and whether transcripts can be enriched or excluded from the neurites regardless of their somatic abundances.
evidence: This is explicitly stated as an open question

claim: mRNA localization is often defined based on either the absolute abundance of a transcript in neurites or the relative enrichment in comparison to somata
source: In fact, mRNA localization is often defined based on either the absolute abundance of a transcript in neurites or the relative enrichment in comparison to somata (Kügelgen and Chekulaeva, 2020).
evidence: This is supported by citation to Kügelgen and Chekulaeva, 2020

claim: Absolute versus relative values can generate significantly different abundance rankings of the mRNAs that comprise local transcriptomes
source: These absolute versus relative values can generate significantly different abundance rankings of the mRNAs that comprise local transcriptomes.
evidence: This is inferred from the different ways of measuring mRNA localization

claim: Absolute values may indicate the number of molecules needed in a compartment
source: These distinctions could be biologically meaningful: absolute values may indicate the number of molecules needed in a compartment (Kosik, 2016), while relative values may reflect regulation of mRNA concentrations between compartments (Liu et al., 2016).
evidence: This is supported by citation to Kosik, 2016

claim: Relative values may reflect regulation of mRNA concentrations between compartments

claim: The method can be scaled to hundreds of single cells
source: Here we developed a method to profile, in an unbiased manner, the transcriptome of subcellular compartments of an individual neuron, which can be scaled to hundreds of single cells.
evidence: This is a primary methodological contribution stated in the introduction

source: We used this method to identify the dendritic and somatic transcriptomes of cultured hippocampal neurons and observed mRNAs in the dendrites of all types of neurons including three GABAergic types.

claim: mRNAs were observed in the dendrites of all types of neurons including three GABAergic types
source: We used this method to identify the dendritic and somatic transcriptomes of cultured hippocampal neurons and observed mRNAs in the dendrites of all types of neurons including three GABAergic types.

claim: Dendritic transcriptomes were different from somatic transcriptomes
source: We found that dendritic transcriptomes were different from somatic transcriptomes and detected distinct patterns of dendritic mRNA variability according to cell type.

claim: Distinct patterns of dendritic mRNA variability were detected according to cell type

claim: Whether an mRNA is dendritically enriched or de-enriched strongly correlates with its cellular function
source: Additionally, we describe the relation between somatic abundance and dendritic localization; we found that whether an mRNA is dendritically enriched or de-enriched strongly correlates with its cellular function.

claim: Proteins are locally synthesized in the dendrites of both glutamatergic and GABAergic neurons
source: Finally, we show that proteins are locally synthesized in the dendrites of both glutamatergic and GABAergic neurons, suggesting mRNA localization and local translation are general neuronal properties.

claim: Laser capture microdissection allows for the dissection of biological material with µm resolution
source: To profile individually the somatic and dendritic transcriptome of a single neuron we used laser capture microdissection (LCM), previously used to profile the transcriptome of individual cells from tissue sections (Foley et al., 2019; Nichterwitz et al., 2016), since it allows for the dissection of biological material with µm resolution.

claim: The method reliably detects RNA species present in as low as four copies per sample
